test_title: PYST 19: SSC CGL - General Awareness (Held On : 20 Aug 2021 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following is a State party as of February 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Aam Aadmi Party.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In April 2011, a civil society movement was born in the **backdrop of big-ticket corruption scandals that came to light during the Congress-led UPA regime.**
 
• The** birth of the AAP on 2nd October 2012 was a watershed moment in India's political history.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Criteria for State Party:**

 
 
• If it secures 6% of the valid votes polled in the state at a general election to the legislative assembly of the state concerned and in addition, it wins 2 seats in the assembly of the state concerned.
 
• If it secures 6% of the valid votes polled in the state at a general election to the Lok Sabha from the state concerned and in addition, it wins 1 seat in the Lok Sabha from the state concerned or If it wins 3% of seats in the legislative assembly at a general election to the legislative assembly of the state concerned or 3 seats in the assembly, whichever is more.
 
• If it wins 1 seat in the Lok Sabha for every 25 seats or any fraction thereof allotted to the state at a general election to the Lok Sabha from the state concerned.
 
• If it secures 8% of the total valid votes polled in the state at a General Election to the Lok Sabha from the state or to the legislative assembly of the state. **This condition was added in 2011**.
